supplier.title: Supplier
supplier.summary: Commercial supplier profile linked to a Nextcloud Contact identity.
supplier.description: Holds the commercial master data for a supplier: catalogue membership, terms-of-trade, category, lead time, and preferred-product list. The supplier's identity (name, address, KvK, VAT, contact persons) lives in a Nextcloud addressbook contact referenced by contactsUid — the 'Contact is a Nextcloud entity' rule. AP/financial fields (IBAN, payment method, credit limit, tax-withholding) are NOT here; those remain on shillinq's Vendor AP profile, keyed by the same contactsUid.

contactsUid.title: Contacts UID
contactsUid.description: Foreign key to the Nextcloud addressbook contact that is the authoritative identity for this supplier. Resolved/created via ContactVcardService.

supplierId.title: Supplier ID
supplierId.description: pipelinq-stable UUID; defaults to and equals the OpenRegister object UUID. This is the FK other pipelinq objects (e.g. product.preferredSupplier) store.

displayName.title: Display name
displayName.description: Denormalised copy of the NC contact name. Kept in sync from the contact on every write; the contact is authoritative.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle status of the supplier relationship.

termsOfTrade.title: Terms of trade
termsOfTrade.description: Commercial terms: incoterm, payment period, currency, minimum order value, and any blanket discount.

incoterm.title: Incoterm
incoterm.description: ICC Incoterms® 2020 code (e.g. EXW, FCA, DAP, DDP).

paymentTermDays.title: Payment term (days)
paymentTermDays.description: Net payment term in calendar days.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this supplier's invoices.

minimumOrderValue.title: Minimum order value
minimumOrderValue.description: Minimum order value in the supplier currency.

discountPercent.title: Blanket discount (%)
discountPercent.description: Blanket trade discount percentage off list prices.

leadTimeDays.title: Lead time (days)
leadTimeDays.description: Default procurement lead time from order placement to delivery, in calendar days.

catalog.title: Supplier catalog
catalog.description: Products available from this supplier. Each entry cross-references a pipelinq product master by productId.

productId.title: Product ID
productId.description: FK to the pipelinq product master (product.productId).

supplierSku.title: Supplier SKU
supplierSku.description: Supplier's own article/item code for this product.

listPrice.title: List price
listPrice.description: Supplier's list price per unit in the terms currency.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this catalog entry (falls back to termsOfTrade.currency).

moq.title: Minimum order quantity
moq.description: Minimum order quantity (units) for this catalog item.

preferred.title: Preferred supplier
preferred.description: Whether this is a preferred (frame-agreement) supplier.

masterEntityRef.title: Master entity ref
masterEntityRef.description: Optional FK into the MDM masterEntity (entityType vendor), so this supplier can join the golden-record layer.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Free-text notes about this supplier relationship.

objects.notes: Demo seed supplier for testing the supplier commercial master.
